book.title: 大众皮卡坐轮船，木偶戏去小岛
book.subtitle: 红皮卡和绿色出租车的跨海接力
book.question: 汽车怎样安全坐渡船？

moral.zh: 不同的交通工具各有本领，遵守规则才能一起平安到达。
moral.en: Different vehicles work together; following safety rules helps everyone arrive safely.

pages.zhText: 同一个早晨，社区木偶剧团也忙起来了。小岛故事节在等他们，周叔叔却望着道具箱发愁：“这些东西，怎么一起过水面呢？”
pages.enText: That same morning, the puppet troupe was busy too. “How can we take all these props across the water?” Mr. Zhou wondered.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Community puppet theatre orange sweater Mr Zhou beside cases, Aunt Lin nearby.

pages.zhText: 林阿姨拍拍红色大众皮卡：“先让我送到码头，再请车客渡船帮忙。”这种船能按规定运送车辆和乘客，但不是每艘轮船都能装汽车。
pages.enText: “The pickup takes us to the dock, then a vehicle ferry helps,” Aunt Lin said. These ferries carry vehicles and passengers. Not every boat carries cars.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Parked RED Volkswagen pickup four doors black bed silver bar Aunt Lin explains to Mr Zhou.

pages.zhText: 两只道具箱、一袋折叠支架，还有装连接件的小盒子。周叔叔对照清单检查，把小盒子收进道具箱。少一件，舞台都可能搭不起来。
pages.enText: Two prop cases, a folding stand bag and a small connector box. Mr. Zhou checked the list and packed the small box inside a case.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Adult orange sweater packs small box into prop case fox puppet visible safe workshop.

pages.zhText: 大人把货物稳稳装好，用固定带绑在货斗固定点上，再检查尾门。货斗只装东西，人要坐驾驶室；木偶狐狸也藏进自己的保护箱。
pages.enText: Adults secured the cargo to the bed's anchor points and checked the tailgate. People ride in the cab; cargo rides in the bed. Fox had a protective case.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Pickup cargo bed two cases long bag strapped securely low, adult checks strap.

pages.zhText: 出发前，林阿姨核对船班和车辆预约信息，也确认车和货物符合这班渡船的要求。“不能到了码头，才发现上不了船呀。”
pages.enText: Aunt Lin checked the sailing, vehicle booking and cargo requirements. “Let's make sure this ferry can take us before we leave.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Aunt Lin phone blank screen next to loaded stationary pickup, no child.

pages.zhText: 路口，她遇见送安安去码头的绿色闪电出租车。两辆车没有追着跑，只在停车时打个招呼：“小岛故事节见！”
pages.enText: At a junction, she saw the green Lightning Taxi taking An'an to the terminal. Nobody raced. They greeted each other while stopped.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Green taxi and red loaded pickup stationary red light separate lanes, wave behind windows.

pages.zhText: 到了港口，出租车去落客区，皮卡去车辆候渡区。路分开了，目的地却相同。林阿姨按指引排队，不占人行通道。
pages.enText: At the port, the taxi went to the drop-off bay and the pickup to the vehicle queue. Different paths, the same destination.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide overhead harbor separate taxi dropoff protected pedestrian route and pickup vehicle queue.

pages.zhText: 队伍暂时没有动。工作人员说，要等前一批车辆离船。周叔叔看看时间，林阿姨说：“慢慢等，比挤过去更能帮上忙。”
pages.enText: The queue waited while vehicles left the arriving ferry. “Waiting patiently helps more than pushing ahead,” Aunt Lin said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Loaded pickup waiting well back from ferry ramp other cars exiting controlled lanes.

pages.zhText: 终于轮到皮卡了。工作人员检查后挥手示意，林阿姨才缓缓向前。宽宽的坡道像一座短桥，把岸和船连起来。
pages.enText: At last, staff signaled them forward. Aunt Lin drove slowly toward the broad ramp linking shore and ferry.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Red loaded pickup approaches broad vehicle ferry ramp crew side protected station no pedestrians.

pages.zhText: 轮胎咕噜咕噜滚上坡道。林阿姨看着指挥，保持距离，没有突然加速。船不是停车场里的玩具，登船也要认真开。
pages.enText: The tires rolled onto the ramp. Aunt Lin followed the signals and kept her distance, driving smoothly and carefully.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Rear threequarter loaded pickup slowly on ferry vehicle ramp high sides no child.

pages.zhText: 进了车辆甲板，皮卡停进指定位置。林阿姨按要求停车、熄火，工作人员再检查安排。两只箱子安安稳稳，没有滑来滑去。
pages.enText: On the vehicle deck, Aunt Lin parked as directed and switched off the engine. Crew checked the arrangement. Both cases stayed secure.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Pickup parked marked lane inside ferry vehicle deck low secured cases, crew inspecting at distance.

pages.zhText: 这班船要求乘客离开车辆甲板。林阿姨和周叔叔带好随身物品，沿指定楼梯去客舱，不留在车里看风景，也不在汽车之间玩耍。
pages.enText: This ferry required passengers to leave the vehicle deck. Aunt Lin and Mr. Zhou took their belongings upstairs, instead of remaining in the car.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Two adults leaving parked pickup toward designated enclosed stairwell, no children vehicle deck.

pages.zhText: 客舱里，有人看书，有人望海。周叔叔抱着随身的小狐狸手偶，轻轻动动它的耳朵：“今天连我也有船票啦！”旁边的小朋友笑了。
pages.enText: In the cabin, people read and watched the sea. Mr. Zhou wiggled his small fox hand puppet. “Even I have a boat trip today!” Children smiled.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Passenger cabin orange sweater man small fox hand puppet Aunt Lin seated families smile.

pages.zhText: 开船后，林阿姨从客舱窗户看见白白的浪花。红皮卡待在下面的指定位置，这一段不用转车轮，也能往小岛前进。
pages.enText: Once underway, Aunt Lin watched the white wake through a cabin window. Below, the parked pickup traveled toward the island without turning its wheels.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Aunt Lin cabin window view white wake island distant, no cutaway or floating car.

pages.zhText: 风渐渐大了，船员暂时关闭露天区域。周叔叔收好手偶，和大家留在室内。“想看海，也要听船员安排。”
pages.enText: The wind rose, and crew temporarily closed the outdoor area. Mr. Zhou put his puppet away. Everyone stayed inside as instructed.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Crew closes exterior deck door guests safely indoors, wind visible outside no storm panic.

pages.zhText: 靠近小岛时，大家仍然耐心等候。直到工作人员通知，林阿姨才和周叔叔回到车辆甲板，检查周围，按安排准备下船。
pages.enText: Near the island, they waited for the crew's announcement before returning to the vehicle deck and preparing to leave.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Adults return designated stair to stationary red pickup ferry docked ramp not yet moving.

pages.zhText: 皮卡缓缓驶下坡道，来到岸上的指定卸货区。接下来去广场的小路只让行人走，不能因为演出快开始，就把车开进人群。
pages.enText: The pickup rolled ashore into the unloading bay. The path to the square was for pedestrians. A coming performance was no reason to drive into a crowd.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Red pickup parked island unloading bay handcart beside, bollards separate crowded distant plaza.

pages.zhText: 手推车接过两只箱子和保护袋。安安和妈妈刚好来到广场：“原来你的皮卡也坐船啦！”林阿姨笑了：“车客渡船送它来的。”
pages.enText: A handcart took the cases and bag. An'an and Mom arrived. “Your pickup rode a boat too!” “A vehicle ferry brought it,” Aunt Lin smiled.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Aunt Lin loaded handcart two cases long bag greets same mom girl on island walkway pickup far parked.

pages.zhText: 周叔叔找出连接件，大家把舞台稳稳搭好。狐狸一探头，孩子们就笑了。绿色出租车没来岛上，却帮安安赶上了这场好故事。
pages.enText: They found the connectors and assembled the stage securely. Fox peeked out, and children laughed. The taxi had stayed ashore, but helped An'an get here.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Island puppet performance fox stage orange sweater puppeteer behind, mom girl seated audience.

pages.zhText: 回程也按同样的规矩来。傍晚，安安在约好的岸边接车点又见到闪电出租车。她说：“你们本领不一样，接在一起，就能把快乐送得更远！”
pages.enText: They followed the same rules going home. That evening, the Lightning Taxi met An'an at the agreed pickup point. “Different jobs together take happiness farther!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Sunset mainland terminal green lightning taxi parked pickup bay mom girl safe pavement distant ferry, warm ending.

parentGuide.goal: 理解水陆交通接力，认识候船、登船与乘船规则。
parentGuide.reminder: 不同船型规定不同，以船方指引为准；不在真实码头模仿游戏。
questions: 出租车、皮卡和渡船各完成了什么任务？
为什么行人和车辆要走不同的通道？
parentGuide.activity: 在家用积木搭码头，用纸盒当渡船，分别画出行人和车辆路线；成人陪同，不在水边游戏。

ageTips.age4to5: 找交通工具的颜色，按顺序讲述登船过程。
ageTips.age6to8: 比较客运船和车客渡船，说明等待和分流的原因。
